test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

Meenal told Renu that she had been a very good football player.

options.text: Meenal said to Renu, "I was a very good football player."
Meenal said to Renu, "I am a very good football player."
Meenal said to Renu, "You have being a very good football player."
Meenal said to Renu, "You had a very good football player."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Meenal told Renu that she had been a very good football player.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"she had been a very good football player" becomes "I was a very good football player"**
 
 
• The pronoun "she" changes to "I" to match direct speech.
 
• The past perfect tense "had been" is changed to the simple past tense "was" for direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "Meenal told Renu"
 
• Converted to: "Meenal said to Renu," to match the direct speech format.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "I" and ends with a period "." inside the quotation marks.
 
• Reporting clause precedes the quoted speech, separated by a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Meenal said to Renu, "I was a very good football player.""*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "Meenal said to Renu, "I am a very good football player.""

 
 
• The tense is incorrect: "am" implies the present tense, which does not match the past context of the indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Meenal said to Renu, "You have being a very good football player.""
 
 
• The phrase "have being" is grammatically incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Meenal said to Renu, "You had a very good football player.""
 
 
• The sentence is grammatically incorrect and changes the meaning entirely.
